prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, black-and-white photograph of a breakfast scene, focusing on a white ceramic plate with a delicate floral pattern along the rim. On the plate are two sunny-side-up eggs, their glossy yolks intact and slightly bulging, with the whites softly set and edges just beginning to crisp. A metal fork is poised above the eggs, its tines gently pressing into one of the yolks, creating a sense of anticipation and subtle tension. The lighting is soft and natural, casting gentle shadows and highlights that accentuate the textures of the eggs and the reflective surface of the fork. The background is softly blurred, with hints of a patterned tablecloth featuring floral motifs, adding a touch of domestic warmth. The overall composition is intimate and cinematic, with a shallow depth of field drawing the viewer’s eye to the tactile details of the food and utensils. The monochrome palette enhances the timeless, contemplative mood, evoking a sense of quiet morning ritual and understated elegance.
